class: A playbook rule evaluated by the background worker with an input the worker never supplies is permanently 'not checked' in the background while it works on the screen, so the one alert the user relies on when no screen is open never comes; the gap is invisible because the screen path, which tests and people look at, has the input.
mechanism: backend/ofo_app/background.py state_from_market (~399-410) passes charge rates None by design ('state_of reads only the gross figures'); T-19 (adjustment cost vs premium left) needs a priced approach, so the worker answers adjust_trigger_no_approach_priced on every check. Same shape found for T-11 in scenario mode: the worker did not set entry_atm_iv (screen does at adjustment_check.py:500); fixed for scenario mode in Stage B1.

first_seen.where: ic-e2e-paper goal run Stage B1 (worker -> gate -> record test over path scenarios)
first_seen.evidence: b1-db5.log B1-OBSERVED: T-19 cost None, reason adjust_trigger_no_approach_priced at every frame; lead read background.py:399-410.

fix: T-19: the worker now loads the screen's charge rates (ADR-254; retry rounds 3-4, merged af4527ed): priced on a throwaway DB (Rs 57.44) and on live prices (A-01 Rs 225.16, read-only shadow 2026-11-06 10:20); the PATH-12 end-to-end test stays a known blocker (expiry-day frames have bid 0.00). Open: T-11 in LIVE mode and worker roll basis (below).

detection.note: tests_app/test_ic_rules_worker_paths.py holds T-19 as a strict known blocker: it turns red when the worker starts raising T-19.

occurrences.evidence: T-19 never checked in the background

occurrences.where: live read-only shadow check on strategy 82 (merged code, real prices)
occurrences.evidence: T-11 not checked: missing_entry_atm_iv in live mode on the screen path and in the worker (no entry IV is set live), so T-11 can never raise on a live strategy; also the worker refuses rolls A-01/A-02/A-05 with 'the roll basis setting for this strategy could not be read' (retry round 4 DB run).
